content:
Ana (AE): Quick sync re: NovaBank POC auth reqs — they asked about SAML IdP metadata, SCIM delta provisioning, RBAC role mapping, and domain control verification for multiple subdomains. Can SE + Security weigh in? Need answers for tomorrow's call. Also flagged pricing sensitivity on reserved connectors.

Evan (SE): Happy to. For SAML we support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. We accept raw metadata XML or a metadata URL. For SCIM we support v2 with delta sync and bulk operations. They specifically asked about PATCH for role updates — we support PATCH and PATCH+PUT fallbacks.

Claire (Security): A few quick security items: we need to confirm SAML assertions include email and groups claims. Do they require an authnContext (MFA/AAL2)? NovaBank mentioned AAL2 in the questionnaire. Also they want audit log retention details and KMS/HSM support.

Evan (SE): We can require authnContext in the SAML settings. For RBAC mapping we offer claim->role rules and group-to-role mapping in the console. Example mapping (will put in the POC doc):
```json
{
  "claim": "groups",
  "map": {
    "bank-admins": "admin",
    "ops": "operator",
    "read-only": "viewer"
  }
}
```

Matt (CS): Pricing question from their procurement: do SCIM calls count as hosted API usage or are they treated as a connector/feature? They want to avoid surprise per-call billing.

Ana (AE): Good one. Evan, is SCIM metered?

Evan (SE): SCIM provisioning traffic is not billed per-token like inference. For hosted customers, SCIM is part of the enterprise connector allowance. For Dedicated we roll it into the reserved capacity price. For POC we can waive connector fees for 90 days — need to confirm in the POC commercial note.

Claire (Security): They also asked about encryption at rest with customer-managed keys and HSM attestations. NovaBank called out 'air-gapped staging for sensitive corp data'. That suggests Private deployment for parts of their workflow. We should clarify which datasets require air-gap.

Ana (AE): Their initial ask: core inference in our hosted region, but identity sync and user provisioning must live inside their VPC for legal reasons. They kept the wording flexible.

Evan (SE): We can support a hybrid: Hosted inference + Private SCIM connector hosted in their VPC, or full Private deployment. Network checklist I recommend we gather for the POC: 
1) IdP metadata (XML or URL)
2) SCIM endpoints + auth method (Bearer token or mTLS)
3) Example user and role schema (claims, group names)
4) Domain verification TXT records for all subdomains they want to claim
5) Expected deprovision SLA and retention window
6) KMS requirements and key policy

ops-bot: Reminder: security questionnaire template (SSO section + KMS checkbox) is at https://redwood.ai/security/questionnaire-template (use this to capture gaps).

Claire (Security): Also: NovaBank requires user deprovision within 24 hours. We need to set expectations — delta SCIM usually propagates within minutes for Dedicated; hosted may depend on IdP webhook reliability. I'll propose language: "we target <30 minutes for hosted delta syncs, <5 minutes for Dedicated" and call out eventual consistency.

Evan (SE): Confirmed — we observe sub-5m for Dedicated in our tests. For hosted we should note variable IdP behavior. I'll include telemetry examples.

Matt (CS): Commercial note: If they commit to Dedicated or Private license we can include SCIM + SSO connectors in the contracted scope at no per-connector fee. For POC concessions, I'll draft a short SOW: 90-day SCIM/SSO support + up to 2 weeks of SE onboarding time.

Ana (AE): Next steps (owners): Evan -> prepare sample SAML metadata + SCIM mapping + propagation SLAs, due EOD today. Claire -> run the security questionnaire vs their answers and flag missing certs/KMS details. Matt -> draft POC commercial terms & legal fallback language. I'll schedule a 10:00 PST sync tomorrow and send the invite.

Evan (SE): On it. Will attach sample IdP metadata and a SCIM test harness we use for validation.

Claire (Security): I'll also request their SOC2 type II report and any FedRAMP-related artifacts if they have them.

Matt (CS): Drafting the POC concession language now, will loop in legal and CSM.

Ana (AE): Thanks team. Please add any blockers you think we should raise before the customer call. :thumbsup:

Evan (SE): One potential blocker — if their IdP enforces signed SCIM requests (mTLS) we may need additional infra config on the Private connector side. Not a showstopper but flagging.

Claire (Security): Also confirm whether they'd accept transient provisioning accounts for the POC (reduced data sensitivity) vs full prod data for the trial.

Ana (AE): Good catch. I'll ask them to confirm data scope in the invite.

Matt (CS): Will include a one-paragraph note on POC data scope in the commercial draft.

Ana (AE): Great — thanks everyone, talk tomorrow.
